chunks: As for what Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā narrated from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Abī al-ʿAlāʾ, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a man who does not know whether he has prayed two rakʿahs or one. He said: “He completes it.”
And what Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn Yaḥyā narrated from al-Sindī ibn al-Rabīʿ, from al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn al-Ḥajjāj, from Abī Ibrāhīm عليه السلام, who said:
Regarding a man who does not know whether he has prayed one rakʿah or two, he said: “He builds upon one rakʿah.”
And what Saʿd ibn ʿAbdillāh narrated from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Abī Naṣr, from ʿAbd al-Karīm ibn ʿAmr, from ʿAbdillāh ibn Abī Yaʿfūr, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a man who does not know whether he has prayed two rakʿahs or one, and he said: “He completes it with one rakʿah.”

key_terms.لَا يَدْرِي: he does not know; expressing uncertainty during salat (prayer)
key_terms.يَبْنِي عَلَى الرَّكْعَةِ: he builds upon one rakʿah; he treats the lower number as the basis
key_terms.يُتِمُّ: he completes; meaning he finishes the prayer accordingly
key_terms.يُتِمُّ بِرَكْعَةٍ: he completes it with one rakʿah

ai.seo_question: What should a person do in salat (prayer) if he doubts whether he has prayed one rakʿah or two?
ai.summary: These narrations give a legal ruling concerning doubt in salat (prayer) about whether one has performed one rakʿah or two. The ruling given is to proceed on the basis of one rakʿah and complete the prayer by adding one more rakʿah.
